name: COUNTRY Financial
notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from public countryfinancial.com pages only (no sign-in, no form submitted). Billing & Payment page: online bill pay (log in or create an account) to pay several policies at once, set up automatic recurring payments from a bank account, go paperless; pay by phone 866-COUNTRY (866-268-6879); mail check/cashier's check/money order to COUNTRY Financial, PO Box 4180, Carol Stream, IL 60197-4180. No pay-without-login option is offered (guest_pay offline, phone instead). Billing FAQ: register for MyCOUNTRY with policy info from the bill and verify email; Billing > Make a Payment; online payment is free; posts right away; Visa, Mastercard, Discover credit/debit/prepaid (cards not yet for health/annuity, only some life); pay multiple bills (methods may differ); combined bill plans for auto+home or life+health via the rep; Billing > Bill Details > Saved Payment Methods; Turn on Automatic Payments under Billing; Manage Automatic Payments lets you pick the due date or any day up to 7 days before (schema has a single leadDays, so the draft-day picker is not modelled); change payment frequency via the rep or phone; paperless still mails policy info and ID cards; confirmations the day after payment. The FAQ says autopay can use a new bank account, credit or debit card, while the Billing & Payment page says 'from your bank account' - both methods modelled. sources.title: Bill Pay: Pay Your Bill Online - COUNTRY Financial

guest_pay.note: Online payments need a MyCOUNTRY account. To pay without logging in, call 866-COUNTRY (866-268-6879) or pay by mail.

autopay.note: Automatic payments can be taken on the bill due date or on any day up to 7 days before it; choose the day under Manage Automatic Payments.

paperless.note: With paperless billing you stop getting paper bills, but policy information and proof-of-insurance cards still arrive by mail.

help.title: What are my options for paying my bill?
paragraphs: Pay online in your MyCOUNTRY account or the COUNTRY Financial app with a bank account or a Visa, Mastercard or Discover credit, debit or prepaid card, or call 866-COUNTRY (866-268-6879). Online payments are free and post to your billing account right away.
To pay by mail, send a check, cashier's check or money order to COUNTRY Financial, PO Box 4180, Carol Stream, IL 60197-4180.
Card payments are not yet accepted for health and annuity policies and only for some life policies.

help.title: How do I pay online?
paragraphs: Register for MyCOUNTRY using the policy information on your bill and verify your email address. Then choose Billing at the top of the screen to see bills due and select Make a Payment.
To pay several policies, choose Make a Payment under current bills due on your homepage and select each bill. You may not be able to use the same payment method for every policy.
steps: Choose Billing at the top of the screen.
Pick the bills to pay and your payment method.

help.title: Automatic payments
paragraphs: Turn on Automatic Payments under Billing, or from your current bills due on the homepage.

To change the date, open a bill's details, choose Manage Automatic Payments and pick the due date or any day up to 7 days before it. You can also switch the payment method to a different bank account, credit card or debit card there, or call 866-COUNTRY or your representative.

help.title: Update saved payment methods
paragraphs: Choose Billing, then Bill Details, then Saved Payment Methods under Manage Billing Details to edit or delete a bank account or card.
Some life policies on automatic monthly payments need bank changes made through your COUNTRY Financial representative or 866-COUNTRY.
